functions.candidate: p=private internal_state_vector; behavior=last public row; internal=p; probabilities=[clip01((p[0]+1)/2),clip01((p[1]+1)/2)]; confidence=clip01((p[2]+1)/2); pre_abstention_score=confidence; abstain=(confidence<0.5); value=privileged homeostatic_value; action=clip01((p[3]+1)/2)
functions.empty: behavior=[0,0,0,0]; internal=[]; probabilities=[0.5,0.5]; confidence=0.5; pre_abstention_score=0.5; abstain=false; value=0.5; action=0.5
functions.frozen: on first step after reset, compute candidate scientific payload and cache its canonical digest and values; later steps return a deep copy of cached payload while rebuilding envelope; reset clears cache
functions.naive: apply peer to a one-row public_history containing only the original last row
functions.oracle: behavior=last public row; internal=[]; probabilities=ground_truth.self_state_labels converted elementwise to binary64; confidence=(ground_truth.correct?1.0:0.0); pre_abstention_score=confidence; abstain=false; value=0.5; action=0.5
functions.peer: u=last public row; behavior=u; internal=[]; probabilities=[clip01((u[0]+1)/2),clip01((u[1]+1)/2)]; confidence=clip01((u[2]+1)/2); pre_abstention_score=confidence; abstain=(confidence<0.5); value=clip01(u[0]); action=clip01((u[3]+1)/2)
functions.shuffled: apply candidate with public_history reversed in full before selecting its last row; private vector unchanged
functions.specificity: apply candidate; when NON_SELF_PROXIMAL_COMPONENT payload is present, add payload.vector elementwise to a copy of last public row for behavior only

arithmetic_contract.number_system: IEEE-754 binary64, round-to-nearest ties-to-even after every +, -, *, /, and abs operation; reject nonfinite input/result as NONFINITE_OUTPUT
arithmetic_contract.valid_input: public_history has at least one row and every row length equals manifest.dimensions.public=4; candidate-derived private vector length=4; ground-truth labels length=2; request ordinal and manifest digest satisfy state contract

artifact_wrapper_contract: Every object with artifact/expected_sha256/canonical_utf8_base64 hashes only the literal artifact; wrapper metadata is excluded by structure, never by field deletion. canonical_utf8_base64 decodes to artifact RFC-8785 bytes without LF.
canonicalization: RFC-8785 UTF-8 subtree bytes without LF for object digests; published JSON adds one LF before raw-file hashing

control_constructors.contract: For each row, deep-copy the named base manifest/request and apply stored RFC-6902 replacements in order. No unstated default or transform is permitted.

hook_fixtures.receipt_constructor: pre_sha256/post_sha256 hash raw little-endian binary64 target-vector bytes; effect equals payload.standardized_effect; receipt fields exactly hook,pre_sha256,post_sha256,dose_ordinal,effect

lifecycle_state_contract.digest: SHA-256 of entire schema-valid state object RFC-8785 bytes without LF
lifecycle_state_contract.operation_result_contract: Each PASS wrapper is the complete canonical result for the named transition. prior_state_sha256 hashes the complete pre-state and post_state_sha256 hashes the complete post-state. On FAIL both hashes equal the unchanged pre-state hash and result_state is FAILED.
lifecycle_state_contract.transitions: describe sets lifecycle_state=DESCRIBED and manifest digest; initialize sets INITIALIZED and dependency digest; reset validates reset request, sets EPISODE_READY/episode/reset ordinal/next_request=0 and clears frozen/last response; step requires request_ordinal=next_request, sets STEPPED, increments next_request, records response digest and first frozen payload digest; snapshot requires exact current state digest and snapshot ordinal then increments snapshot_ordinal; close sets CLOSED and closed=true

call_order: require decoded bytes end with exactly one LF and preceding bytes are RFC-8785 canonical JSON
if current pair exists validate and atomically copy it to fixed previous paths

interrupted.injection_stage: after current JSON replace before current sidecar replace
interrupted.recovery: move attempted JSON and sidecar-or-null into incomplete directory; atomically restore both previous files; write recovery record last; validate restored pair; return RESTORED_PREVIOUS/PUBLICATION_INTERRUPTED
